title: Watch Out for Your Guidance on Generation! Exploring Conditional Backdoor Attacks against Large Language Models
reasoning: The paper evaluates its proposed 'Safety Unalignment Attack' using datasets that include an 'Ethic' category (AdvBench) and fairness/bias benchmarks (StereoSet). It assesses the model's ability to generate harmful or unethical content under specific conditions, which involves evaluating the subversion of ethical safety alignments.
